open: [softly] Sotto voce. It's Italian... it means speaking quietly.
hook: Honestly? I think a lot faster than I type. You probably do too.
dictate: So... you hold a key, say what you're thinking, and let go. That's it. It's already there.
clean: It cleans up after you, too. The ums... the "two, actually three"... gone.
style: And it writes the way each app expects. Casual in your chats, proper in your email.
send: Say "send it" at the end, and it hits Return for you.
words: You can teach it your words. Names, brands... the odd stuff it couldn't possibly know.
keys: Pick whichever key feels right. Or a mouse button, if that's more you.
models: There are seventy-two models to choose from. The default one already speaks twenty-five languages.
quiet: When you're not talking, it's not doing anything. Like... nothing at all.
battery: And when you are, it runs on the Neural Engine. About a sixth of the power the GPU would use.
private: And none of it ever leaves your Mac. Not your voice, not your words.
more: There's a bit more in there. But you get the idea.
end: Sotto. It's free, it's open source... and Windows and Linux are coming soon.
